verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers search, registration, pricing, DNS, renewal, lock, forwarding, MCP/CLI tooling, and commerce APIs, but nowhere documents the breadth of TLDs offered or per-TLD special requirements (e.g., restricted extensions, ccTLD nexus rules). This axis clearly applies to a registrar, but no citation addresses TLD catalog size or per-extension documentation, so there is no evidence the story is delivered.
